Nina Gomez: Quick kickoff  SkyPort marketplace + joint webinar. Need final listing copy, a short benchmark callout for the blog, and inbound routing to SFDC. Can we do a 20m dry-run Fri 11am PT?
Liam Fox: Fri 11am PT works. Checklist: landing copy, CTA tracking (marketplace_click_id), slides, and SFDC mapping.
Priya Shah: I'll draft the blog with a 3-bullet benchmark box. Tentative conservative numbers: ~1.4x median latency reduction and ~10% cost delta using our caching. Will include methodology note.
Kara (SkyPort): SkyPort marketing can supply anonymized traces and a partner quote. Comms will review listing copy by Thu EOD.
Ellen Park: SFDC mapping: please set lead_source=skyport_marketplace and utm_campaign=skyport_q3. Route utm_medium=marketplace leads to partners_sdr_queue.
Nina Gomez: Keep the registration minimal: name, email, company, role, interest checkbox, partner opt-in. Add hidden marketplace_click_id param.
Liam Fox: I'll prepare a 30s pre-recorded failover demo and the slides. Also will size the hero perf graph for the marketplace listing.
Priya Shah: Uploading benchmark one-pager and PNG now. Will add the methodology blurb: "Results from joint internal tests on sample catalogs; individual results may vary."
Kara (SkyPort): Legal approves with that blurb. We'll send logo and lockups Tue AM. Also will provide a 1-line quote for the listing.
marketing-bot: Shortlink created: https://go.redwood/skyport-launch. UTM defaults set: utm_source=partner, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=skyport_q3. Reminder set for dry-run Fri 11:00 PT.
Ellen Park: Post-webinar nurture: day 0 recording, day 3 benchmark one-pager + blog, day 10 AE outreach. Make sure the blog includes an eval kit link for SDRs.
Nina Gomez: Action recap: Priya - blog + benchmark (Thu EOD). Liam - slides + clip (Thu EOD). Ellen - SFDC routing (Fri AM). Kara - assets + quote (Thu AM).
Liam Fox: Added smoke test to rehearsal checklist: verify marketplace CTA preserves marketplace_click_id across redirects.
Nina Gomez: Thanks all  I'll post a pre-read Thu morning with links. See you on the dry-run.
